title: Legal & Pricing: Data sovereignty checklist and enterprise pricing impact analysis
creator: Marina Patel
description: Create a customer-facing playbook and internal contract framework for EU/UK data residency requests and SCCs, including a subprocessor matrix, default retention policies, and a pricing/packaging experiment plan to cover costs of regional isolation (hosted vs. dedicated vs. private). Deliverables: residency checklist, templated contract language for SCCs & UK Addendum, subprocessor disclosure spreadsheet, recommended retention defaults by product surface, and two pricing experiment proposals (add-on surcharge vs. tiered regional SKUs).
acceptance_criteria: 1) Residency playbook PDF and Confluence page published; 2) Subprocessor matrix (CSV link) attached to playbook; 3) Legal-approved SCC/UK Addendum draft uploaded; 4) Pricing experiment proposal with modeled unit economics and sample SKUs presented to GTM+Finance; 5) Implementation ticket list for Console and Billing owners created.
comments: 2025-03-11 - Kickoff with Legal (A. Reyes) and Security (T. Huang). Agreed scope: EU/UK SCCs + UK Addendum, subprocessors disclosure, and retention guardrails for hosted API vs Dedicated/Private.

2025-03-12 - Decision: default retention for hosted API logs = 30 days; onboarding teams can opt into 90/365 with paid retention add-on. PM/Finance want a separate SKU for 365 retention to recover storage + compliance review costs.

2025-03-13 - Engineering feedback from ENG-4820: Console needs a 'data residency' flag and API header (X-Redwood-Region-Pin) for routing. Add implementation estimate: 5 sprint days for UI + 3 backend days for routing metadata + 2 days for audit log schema change.

2025-03-14 - Legal review note: SCCs require subprocessors appendix per contract. Legal requests a CSV with subprocessor name, location, role, data types processed, and transfer mechanisms. Action: Product to own canonical CSV and sync to docs on contract signature.

2025-03-15 - Pricing brainstorm: two experiments proposed: (A) 'Regional Pin' add-on priced as 30% premium on hosted per-token rates for EU region; (B) 'Residency Pack' fixed monthly fee by capacity band for Dedicated customers. Finance asked for model with 12-month ARR impact and uplift thresholds.

2025-03-16 - PM review with Solutions Eng: create 4 sample customer personas (SaaS SMB, Healthcare mid-market, Finance enterprise, Gov agency) and map expected acceptance of premium options. Solutions Eng to draft sample contract language for sales plays.
Follow-ups: create ENG tickets for API header, Console flag, Billing SKU, and a Legal PRD for SCCs/UK addendum. Link PRs and Confluence in links below.
